rationale: The short thesis relied on a breakdown below $30.30 support and price remaining beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA. Both conditions have failed as price reversed higher to $30.52, reclaiming the $30.30 breakdown level and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($30.38) through a sequence of higher 1-minute lows. Exiting now cuts the failed breakdown before it reaches the $30.80 hard invalidation, while overhead VWAP resistance at $31.11 makes flipping to long unfavorable.
